hero.heading: Computer Architecture Lab
hero.intro: The course page for lab sheets, announcements, schedules, and resources shared during class.

resources.title: General Lab Instructions
resources.summary: Lab setup, Icarus Verilog and GTKWave commands, test-bench conventions, backups, and common Verilog mistakes.

announcements.title: Welcome to CS F342 Lab
announcements.body: This portal is the home for P4 and P7 lab material. Bookmark it and check the latest notice before each session.

announcements.title: Lab sheets will appear here
announcements.body: Downloads will be published as they are released. A sheet marked ‘Coming soon’ is not yet available.

labs.title: Getting Started with Verilog
labs.summary: Icarus Simulator, Verilog primitives, modelling styles, and introductory HDL exercises.

labs.title: Combinational Circuit Modeling
labs.summary: Gate-level 4x1 multiplexer, a hierarchical 16x1 multiplexer built from it, and a decoder-based full adder.

labs.title: Sequential Circuit Modeling
labs.summary: D flip-flops, blocking vs. non-blocking assignment, a Mealy-machine FSM example, and a 4-bit shift register.

policies.title: Attendance deadline
policies.text: You must report before 2:10 PM. Attendance will not be granted after 2:10 PM except in genuine cases accepted by the lab instructor.

policies.title: No mobile phones
policies.text: Mobile phones must remain inside your bag throughout lab hours. They must not be on the desk, in your hand, or outside your bag.

policies.title: Come prepared
policies.text: Read the current lab sheet, complete any pre-lab work, and bring the required files to your assigned session.
